description: MiXplorer Sharing Fix 0.2.0. Supports com.mixplorer 6.71.15 (ARM64 build 26090422) and com.mixplorer.beta 6.71.15-BETA (ARM64 build 26090412), Android 11+. Hides unreadable _data paths from external file-sharing recipients and includes local-signing support. Stable tested on-device with a diagnostic receiver; live Telegram uploads remain unverified. Back up settings before replacing an officially signed installation.
